propositions: The rebar metrics CLI subcommand must parse --since/--until date range arguments and --output format flag (json or text) and render the full metric registry over that range
Registry hydration requires importing the rebar.metrics package (not just registry module) to trigger reader side-effects that populate REGISTRY
The metrics command must construct a context object carrying repo_root, since, and until, and pass it to registry.evaluate() for each MetricSpec without direct imports of rebar.metrics.adapters
The render loop must wrap each evaluate() call in try/except to isolate metric failures and emit unavailable rather than crashing, ensuring every registered metric id appears in output

JSON output format must be {since, until, metrics: {id: {lens, source, confidence, value} or {unavailable: {reason, accruing_since}}}}, while text output is one line per metric with id, lens/source, and value-or-unavailable

The metrics subcommand must be routed by explicit if-arm in _dispatch() (not frozenset membership), added to the individual routable subcommands frozenset, with help text and overview coverage, and golden snapshots regenerated
